name: Kurata Rinko
source:
She remarried his father when Shizuya was young.

She is graceful but strong at heart. Even after her husband's death, she does not tell him that she is his step mother. She loves Shizuya as if he were her own son.

She has a neat and innocent atmosphere, but has a voluptuous body. She is affectionate and protective of her late husband's fidelity. She still wears her wedding ring.

[From [url=http://www.hs-crowd.co.jp/anim/product/pro_pc/pc084/index.html]official site[/url]]
